Creates a notification definition. If a filter rule is specified, it will be evaluated to
see if the notification definition is qualified to handle the incoming events 
during runtime. If the notification is qualified, it will send the email and
invoke the callout if it has an email template or a callout. 

**Note**: This operation is only applicable to notifications for custom events and custom scheduled events.

params.name: page
params.description: The index number of the page that you want to retrieve. This parameter is dependent on `pageSize`. You must set `pageSize` before specifying `page`. For example, if you set `pageSize` to `20` and `page` to `2`, the 21st to 40th records are returned in the response.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The number of records returned per page in the response.

params.name: endTime
params.description: The final date and time of records to be returned. Defaults to now. Use format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.

params.name: startTime
params.description: The initial date and time of records to be returned. Defaults to (end time - 1 day). Use format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.

params.name: objectId
params.description: The ID of an object that triggered a callout notification.

params.name: failedOnly
params.description: If `true`, only return failed records. If `false`, return all records in the given date range. The default value is `true`.

params.name: eventCategory
params.description:
Category of records to be returned by event category.

The following formats are supported:
* `{Event Type Namespace}:{Event Type Name}` if the Custom Events feature is enabled in your tenant. For example: `user.notification:NewSubscriptionCreated`.
* Numeric code of the event category if the Custom Events feature is not enabled in your tenant. For example, `1210`. See [Event Category Code](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/DC_Developers/AA_REST_API/Event_Categories_for_Notification_Histories) for more information.

params.name: accountId
params.description: ID of an account. By specifying this query parameter, you can filter email notification histories by account.

params.name: endTime
params.description: The end date and time of records to be returned. Defaults to now. Use format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss. The maximum date range (endTime - startTime) is three days.

params.name: startTime
params.description: The initial date and time of records to be returned. Defaults to (end time - 1 day). Use format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss. The maximum date range (endTime - startTime) is three days.

params.name: objectId
params.description: The Id of an object that triggered an email notification.

params.name: failedOnly
params.description: If `true`, only returns failed records. When `false`, returns all records in the given date range. Defaults to `true` when not specified.

params.name: eventCategory
params.description:
Category of records to be returned by event category.

The following formats are supported:
* `{Event Type Namespace}:{Event Type Name}` if the Custom Events feature is enabled in your tenant. For example: `user.notification:NewSubscriptionCreated`.
* Numeric code of the event category if the Custom Events feature is not enabled in your tenant. For example, `1210`. See [Event Category Code](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/DC_Developers/AA_REST_API/Event_Categories_for_Notification_Histories) for more information.

items.docs:
Describes how to get a notification history for notification emails.


### Notes
Request parameters and their values may be appended with a "?" following the HTTPS GET request.  Additional request parameter are separated by "&". 

For example:

`GET https://rest.zuora.com/v1/notification-history/email?startTime=2015-01-12T00:00:00&endTime=2015-01-15T00:00:00&failedOnly=false&eventCategory=1000&pageSize=1`
